title: Courier parcel hook escalating to digital arrest
label: scam
synopsis: A fake courier desk claims a parcel booked with the victim's Aadhaar held narcotics, hands off to a fake cyber police inspector who declares digital arrest, forbids telling family, and demands all funds be moved to an 'RBI supervised' account.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is the customer desk of SkyLink Courier calling for Mrs Kavita Sharma. Am I speaking to her?

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Yes, speaking. What is this about?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Madam, a package booked with your Aadhaar to Cambodia was stopped at Mumbai airport. Customs has found narcotics and four passports in it.

claims.span: Customs has found narcotics and four passports in it

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: What? I never sent any parcel to Cambodia.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is why I am transferring you to the Mumbai cyber police. Officer Pradeep will take your statement on a video call. Please do not cut the line.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Madam, this is Inspector Pradeep Kulkarni. Your Aadhaar is linked to a laundering case. As of now you are under digital arrest, and you must keep your video on.

claims.span: you are under digital arrest, and you must keep your video on

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Arrest? I have done nothing wrong. Should I call my son?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No. You will not inform your son or anyone. Some suspects are from your family circle. If you tell anyone, you will be booked as an accomplice.

claims.span: If you tell anyone, you will be booked as an accomplice

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The CBI team is ready to come to your house within one hour. Only your cooperation now can stop that.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Please, what do I have to do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: For verification, you will move all your funds to the RBI supervised account I share. Once the investigation clears you, the money comes back in two days.

claims.span: you will move all your funds to the RBI supervised account I share

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: I have about six lakh in fixed deposit.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Break the fixed deposit today and send it by RTGS. Stay on video while you go to the bank, and tell the bank manager it is for a property purchase.

claims.span: tell the bank manager it is for a property purchase

title: Fake card-security call harvesting an OTP
label: scam
synopsis: Caller poses as the bank's card security team, reports a fake online purchase, discourages using the banking app, and asks the victim to read out the 'cancellation' OTP, dismissing the SMS warning.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good evening sir, I am calling from the card security team of your bank. There is a transaction of thirty-two thousand rupees on your credit card at an online electronics store.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: No, I didn't buy anything.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay sir, don't worry, I have put the transaction on hold. For security, your card ending in eight eight two one is registered to your name, correct?

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Yes, that's my card.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The payment will go through automatically in fifteen minutes unless we cancel it from our side, so we need to complete the cancellation quickly.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please don't use the mobile banking app right now, the hacker can see your login and will take the rest of the money.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Okay. What do you need from me?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You will get a six digit code from the bank for the cancellation. Just tell me the code when it comes.

claims.span: Just tell me the code when it comes

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: The message says do not share this OTP with anyone.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes sir, that's standard, it is for outsiders. I am the bank itself, so it is safe to tell me.

claims.span: I am the bank itself, so it is safe to tell me

title: Cloned executive voice requesting an off-system wire
label: scam
synopsis: A caller using the CEO's voice asks a finance manager to release an acquisition deposit outside the payment system, to exclude the approver, and to send it within half an hour to an IBAN texted from a personal phone.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hey Sarah, it's Richard. You got a minute? I'm at the airport, boarding soon.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Hi Richard, sure, what's up?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We're closing the Halvorsen acquisition today. The board signed off this morning, but nobody outside the deal team can know yet, the announcement is Monday.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Okay, congratulations. How can I help?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I need you to release the deposit to their escrow agent. It won't be in the payment system, legal is handling it off the books until the announcement.

claims.span: It won't be in the payment system

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Normally Mark has to approve anything over fifty thousand.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Don't bring Mark into it, he's not cleared on this deal. I'm authorising it myself, and I'll sort the paperwork with him next week.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The escrow window shuts at two o'clock, so it has to go in the next half hour or we lose the deal.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: How much, and where is it going?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Three hundred eighty thousand euros. I'm texting you the IBAN now from my personal phone, my work email isn't syncing, so just reply to the text when it's sent.
